title: FERRUM: a visualisation core for volumetric medical images
description: FERRUM is a reusable visualisation core for volumetric medical images (DICOM and NIfTI) written in Rust: a GPU desktop viewer with 2D, MPR and 3D volume rendering, measurements and segments; an open protocol for out-of-process segmentation engines (ferrum-engine/1); and a headless command line and MCP server that let AI agents use it as a skill (ferrum-agent/1).
